pilots.sourceExcerpt:
Before looking at the resource map, ask one question:

If OMP is a Pi fork, can AIWG safely map `omp` to the existing `pi` provider?

The answer is no.
pilots.proposed:
AIWG has an experimental Oh My Pi integration with the provider id `omp`. Its native paths and session behavior require a distinct adapter.

Preview with `aiwg use sdlc --provider omp --dry-run`. Installation, models, credentials and trust decisions remain operator-owned. Local Linux checks do not qualify every runtime configuration.

Which workflow should we test first?

AIWG has an experimental Google Antigravity CLI integration: `antigravity`, with alias `agy`. Workspace skills use `.agents/skills/`; global skill paths remain unresolved.

Preview with `aiwg use sdlc --provider antigravity --dry-run`. Offline conformance is pinned to local CLI `1.1.26` observation; authenticated model execution has not been qualified. Installation, authentication, model selection and permissions remain operator-owned.
